title.narrative: Promoting and defending human rights with vulnerable sectors in El Salvador.

description.narrative: This initiative seeks to contribute to the exercise of citizens' rights, for which it will carry out training, advocacy and legal and psychological support actions where beneficiaries know and promote their rights, receive dignified attention and support in their cases, as well as improving their security strategies. It is framed within the new legal and "security" scenario where there are no guarantees in administrative and legal processes in current cases of human rights violations since 27 March 2022, when the Parliament declared a regime of exception in El Salvador. Likewise, this same scenario is currently being violated in cases of serious human rights violations in the past and current armed conflict, where there is great passivity on the part of judges and prosecutors, as well as the territorial disarticulation that has taken place in communities where militar operations have been carried out. Tutela Legal MJH, is one of the few institutions that has continued struggling for justice and truth in these issues, so it is hoped that this project will contribute to continue supporting victims and their families. The project aims for the recognition of the victims and their comprehensive care, as well as strengthening and advocacy actions in coordination with other human rights organisations and bodies at national and regional level.
